about_the_game:
After a rough crash landing you find yourself in a breathtaking yet lethal tropical paradise. Every day will be a challenge, because survival isn’t just for show! You'll have to take care of yourself and your girlfriends, adapt to the local flora and fauna, conquer, build, learn and… breed your way to becoming the master of your own dangerous utopia.

1. CONQUER THE WILDERNESS

  • Forage & Craft: Hunt, forage and harvest to build essential tools, weapons and shelter.

  • Adapt or Perish: Learn the island's deadly rhythms, hostile wildlife, shifting weather, and hidden environmental dangers.

2. TAME & BREED YOUR LEGACY

  • Forge Real Relationships: Each monster girl has a complex personality, backstory and desires. Win their loyalty through conversations, gifts and tailored interactions.

  • Master Genetics: Breed your perfect girls with specific physical traits, skills and personalities. Create the ultimate tribe and watch your legacy unfold across generations.

  • A Village That Grows With You: Start with a simple camp and grow into a bustling village!

  • Monster Girls for Every Taste: a mischievous catgirl who lives for food, naps, and cuddling up next to you; a sweet and curious octopus girl; a strong, independent hunter jackalope girl; a sneaky and cunning maned wolf girl; a demon-possessed but smart and curious cow girl; a powerful yet gentle minotaur woman; and a feisty fairy with a sharp tongue and an even sharper attitude.

    And that's not all! The catmen tribe Shaman — a massive, ominous and strangely alluring main antagonist you won't soon forget.

  • Cinematic, Player-Driven Intimacy: A lot of different styles of realtime 3D hot scenes with multiple angles, interactions and choices that make every moment personal and immersive.

  • Breeding: Experiment with different poses and discover new ones hidden in ancient paintings across the island. Watch as bellies grow, and yes, you can enjoy steamy moments with your pregnant beauties! The birth process, after which you receive an egg; collect eggs and raise the next generation in special nest-incubators. Want your new girl to inherit specific traits from a chosen "nurse"? Or prefer fine-tuning through DNA editing? The choice is yours!

  • Minigames for Every Mood: A wild mix of challenges awaits! Test your wits with puzzles and riddles, sneak past enemies in stealth missions, or prove your reflexes in dynamic action sequences. And of course — fishing! Cast your line and discover a vibrant collection of tropical fish. Each new catch can be admired from every angle in your personal gallery. Gotta catch 'em all!

  • A Mystery to Unravel: Where is the missing pilot, Tonya? What happened to the ancient civilization? What secrets are your girls holding? Your discoveries will change the island's fate and yours.

  • Village Sim: Craft, farm and customize your settlement with amenities that your harem will love.

  • Language: The locals have their own language. Yes, even your girls. That means misunderstandings, laughs and plenty of awkwardness. But don't worry, you'll get a chance to learn it. Search for ancient steles scattered across the island and master new words through a simple minigame. 

  • Branching Story: Multiple endings shaped by your decisions, will you be a tender lover or a dominant conqueror?

Ready to Build Your Paradise?

The campfire is lit, the jungle whispers your name and a pair of curious eyes is watching you from the treeline. Will you build an empire of comfort and passion, or will the island's dark heart consume you?

Start your journey today. The ultimate survival harem experience is here!

content_descriptors.notes: In our game, you build the harem village of your dreams. Different girls like different kinks, nothing extreme, but most of them are open to breeding and pregnancy. In the game you will have to protect your girls from the attack of enemies, and also fight with wild animals that can kill you or any of the villagers.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent

  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 980 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD equivalent

  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080 or AMD equivalent
